sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, the division's current leaders with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The visitors sit bottom of the table with just 4 points from 10 matches and have won only once in their last six outings, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to extend their impressive recent form of five consecutive wins and a draw.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture between mid-table sides, with Stafford looking to build on their recent draw. AFC Bridgnorth, who sit third with 19 points, host Eccleshall in what should be a competitive encounter between two strong teams. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, face Wednesfield Community at home as they look to bounce back from their recent performance. The in-form Bilston Town (5th, 17 points) welcome Foley Meir in a clash of mid-table sides. Barnton, currently 7th, travel to Shawbury United in a fixture between teams in the lower half. New Mills, languishing in 8th place with recent losses, head to Market Drayton Town; both sides are struggling in the table. Crewe, one of the division's poorest performers, entertain Allscott Heath on home soil as they seek to arrest a poor run of form. Cheadle Heath Nomads, near the foot of the table with just 7 points, travel to Telford Town—a basement battle between two struggling sides—while Widnes Town, pointless at the bottom, visit Brereton Social in another fixture involving teams fighting for survival.
